title: Pigeon Simulator: Survival Mode
author: sugarw0000kie
selftext:
**tl;dr** the pigeons know nothing about the world or the mechanics at the start. Turns out survival mechanics were too aggressive and by me asking them about the kiwi egg at the start they spiraled thinking it was important, so they protected it and didn't plant any food until too late. Twentyracoons was the last pigeon waddling 

**4 pigeons 1 island**  
In the video: sweatpants, froggyfroggertonthethird, gonorrhea and twentyracoons

They aren't told in prompting what they are or what to do specifically but are rewarded by trying new (non repetitive) things. at the start theyre usually figuring out what they are with vision and trying random things. The pigeons don't know the game mechanics at all and need to experiment to figure it out. 

1-2 agents seem to do better at survival and discovering the mechanics (plant food + eat = no die), more than that and they can feed off each other in unproductive ways, but they seem to "play" more, if you can call it that

Feed  
I set up an endpoint to watch/listen in the background, so the video comes from that. i needed a national graphic narrator desperately. it has access to everything the agents are doing and knows the mechanics of the game, has its own memory, but the pigeons don't know about it, and the narrator doesn’t know the pigeons don’t know how the game works. The audio stream muxes some music over the breeze/TTS

As the instances run it records the actions of the pigeons for the last several hours along with the audio stream so it can just play back without needing to re-run through the TTS again.

In realtime there's long gaps waiting for responses from LLM and then again on TTS, it can go several minutes of silence since the LLMs are mainly focused on driving the pigeons, so i could run the stream in the background doing other things and get updates from the trusty narrator. Video is edits that out but pigeons are doing/saying their own things

No public feed yet maybe in future 

**Why they all died**  
Other runs with 1-2 agents did fine. more agents seemed to "play" with each other more but drifted from goals like planting seeds and accepted other pigeons statements as fact even if wrong

I said something about kiwi eggs in beginning and came back to it several hours later.

There's only 1 shell on the map (1 blue ball, 1 shiny pebble, 1 shell). They thought the shell was an egg, and since there's only 1 it's rare/valuable, so they "protected it" by carrying it everywhere. then an agent died with it equipped and re-spawned (they have 3 lives), so they thought it was some sort of re-spawn item.

Basically looks like it nudged them down a cascade of wrong assumptions in a positive feedback loop that prevented them from recognizing the need for food until it was too late

**How built**  
opencode/mcode using mostly minimax 3.1 flash with some deepseek 4.1 flash. Backend is python fastapi with job scheduler dispatch for the models with celery, frontend is three.js.

The pigeon models:

LLM: iceman-free

Embedding: [nomic-embed-text-v1.5](https://huggingface.co/nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5)

TTS: [Breeze-TTS-2-mlx-4bit](https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Breeze-TTS-2-mlx-4bit)

3d model: [https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/dancing-pigeon-a78570e7598d444197af354e03f4022b](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/dancing-pigeon-a78570e7598d444197af354e03f4022b)

**Pigeon bodies**  
They have a basic "nervous system" that handles body movements, some basic "senses" so they have feedback on their body parts positioning, memory with dream consolidation and embedding, and see the world in front of them conically from the vantage point of their head in descriptive text.They can use vision with 1st/3rd person viewing.

An attention gating system helps the LLM drive the pigeons from a higher level, the “nervous system”handles the details, and the voice model is slapped on top

The nervous system is the reason why I could say “turn your head to the right” and the body responded immediately, and LLM call would have taken several seconds.

Full local was bad idea with the LLM. the embedding model is small, the 4b breeze/tts i can run locally. gemma/bonzai weren't doing terrible but both being just really small gave a lot of repetitive non-interesting behavior and became pretty slow for >1 agents so switched to using API models.
